journey.name: paykit quoted usdt requests
journey.description: Two linked Bitkit wallets with Paykit and USDT enabled, sharing enabled by their owners, and a fresh BTC/USD rate. Ordinary request-creation checks can stop at Amount without funds. The controlled quote checks need a linked test peer and sufficient regtest balance to reach confirmation; do not authorize a payment. Funded settlement, later installments and controlled evidence checks are manual tests in docs/usdt-qa.md.

actions.action: Open a linked contact and create a USD payment request. Verify BTC and USD are the denomination choices and enabled receiving methods start selected. Verify one Savings choice covers Bitcoin address types, Spending appears when Lightning is enabled, and USDT is available.
Deselect all receiving choices and verify sending the request is disabled. Select only USDT, enter 1 USD, select an expiry and send the request.

On the payer, open the request. Verify Amount shows exactly $1 with USDT selected as the payment method, the amount cannot be edited, and no Bitcoin funding source is offered. Continue to USDT review. Verify Payment Request, the requester avatar, From and For summary, exact dollar amount and additional fee. Open details and verify Contact, recipient address and the invoice note. Close without swiping to pay.

Create a BTC request accepting Bitcoin and USDT. On the payer's Amount screen, switch between available Savings, Spending and USDT sources. Verify the displayed amount preserves the request's quoted value and cannot be edited. Close without continuing.

With a linked test payer, open a quoted request for 1000 USD requiring 1 BTC while Bitkit's BTC/USD rate is 2000. Verify the request details label 1000 USD as Requested amount. On payment review, verify 1 BTC and Bitkit's approximately 2000 USD valuation. Close without paying.

Open a BTC request with different quoted prices for Bitcoin and Lightning. Switch Savings and Spending and verify the payable BTC amount changes to the selected method's quoted amount. Verify the confirmation uses Bitkit's own fiat valuation and requires approval. Close without paying.

Create a USD subscription. Verify only USDT is accepted at fixed 1:1 parity. Propose it to the linked contact. On the payer, review its dollar amount, recurrence and USDT payment method; close before subscribing.
Create a BTC subscription and verify that only enabled Savings and Spending methods are accepted, with no USDT choice. Close without proposing.
